comments.text: Tried taking the ferry first, but it only goes with 4 or more people, so we decided to hitchhike. We hitched while walking to the main road and got a ride straight to Salto.

spots.descriptionEn: Roadside spot. Average wait: 15 min. Tested by 1 hitchhiker. Tried taking the ferry first, but it only goes with 4 or more people, so we decided to hitchhike. We hitched while walking to the main road and got a ride straight to Salto.
